evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive performed as a settled, load-bearing instruction — the speaker expects compliance, not debate; but no identity-level permanence language lifts it to principle.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Imperative performed as a settled operational command — expects execution, not discussion; the absoluteness of 'all' adds commitment but the directive form stays at decision, not principle.
